title: the-dead-lamp
characterStill: Photorealistic candid portrait of an old lighthouse keeper, centered, seventies, weathered sea-worn skin. Face-lock: a deep vertical scar splitting his left eyebrow, a broad nose flattened by an old break, heavy iron-grey brows shelving deep-set pale eyes, cropped white stubble beard, and a high receded hairline of wiry white hair. He wears all of: a stiff oiled-canvas storm coat darkened at the shoulders, a ribbed charcoal wool sweater, cracked leather suspenders, and fingerless grey wool gloves. Motivated amber light from a brass hand-lantern rakes one cheek; cold sea-green window light fills the other. Shallow depth of field, fine 35mm film grain, palette of oxidized brass, wet slate, kerosene amber, sea-green. 16:9.
setStill: Photorealistic interior of a lighthouse lantern room at storm dusk, late afternoon light nearly gone. Centerpiece: a great first-order Fresnel lens, a barrel of concentric brass-caged glass rings, standing dead and dark on its iron pedestal. Salt haze streaks the curved storm glass; rain slams it in sheets. Textures of age: green verdigris on brass fittings, flaking white paint, rust weeping down rivets, worn oak floorboards slick with tracked water. One named light source, a brass hand-lantern hooked on the gallery rail, throws amber across the rings. Shallow depth of field, fine 35mm film grain, palette of oxidized brass, wet slate, kerosene amber, sea-green. 16:9.

shots.title: the-lamp-is-dead
shots.firstFrame: Wide shot, low camera height from the floorboards, of the room from the reference image. The man from the reference image stands off-center in the right third, facing frame-left, one hand flat on the cold pedestal of the great lamp, which is dead and dark. An oilcloth tool roll sits unopened in the blurred foreground. The brass hand-lantern on the rail is the only living light. Rain floods the curved storm glass behind him.
shots.motion: Camera pushes in slowly at floor height. The man from the reference image turns his head toward the storm glass at an off-screen sound, hesitating with his palm still on the dead lamp's pedestal, his breath fogging in the cold air, leaving a smeared handprint in the salt dust. One continuous take. SFX: a distant ship's bell off-screen, rain hammering glass, brass ticking as it cools. Ambient noise: wind pressure moaning through the gallery door, the hand-lantern's flame guttering.

shots.title: what-the-sea-holds
shots.firstFrame: POV shot through the salt-streaked storm glass of the room from the reference image, eye-level, no person in frame. Curved glass and a verdigris brass mullion frame the left foreground. Far below and off-center right, black water breaks white over a reef, and one weak yellow ship's light rides toward it. The unopened oilcloth tool roll sits blurred at the bottom edge of frame.
shots.motion: Camera holds, then drifts a few inches right as rain sheets across the glass. The distant ship's light rises and vanishes behind a wave, then reappears closer to the reef, leaving the water torn white where it struck. One continuous take. SFX: rain bursting on glass, the ship's bell thinning off-screen, a low structural groan. Ambient noise: wind in the lantern-room seams, surf booming far below.

shots.title: the-tool-roll
shots.firstFrame: Medium shot, low camera height, of the room from the reference image. The man from the reference image kneels off-center in the left third, facing frame-left, unrolling the oilcloth tool roll across wet floorboards. The great lamp is dead and dark, its brass rings looming out of focus in the right foreground. Amber from the brass hand-lantern edges his shoulders; sea-green window light fills behind.
shots.motion: Camera tilts down and slightly in as he kneels. The man from the reference image flattens the oilcloth tool roll with a cold-stiff hand, fumbles the first tie, tries again, and lifts the flap to reveal the spare brass burner nozzle, water beading and running off the cloth onto the boards. One continuous take. SFX: wet canvas unrolling, a spanner clinking, knees cracking. Ambient noise: rain on glass, a shutter banging off-screen below.

shots.title: the-spare-nozzle
shots.firstFrame: Macro insert, high camera height looking almost straight down at the opened oilcloth tool roll on wet floorboards. Two blurred fingertips of the man from the reference image are already mid-lift on the spare brass burner nozzle, off-center left. The nozzle's threads catch amber from the brass hand-lantern. The dead, dark great lamp is a soft brass shape at the top of frame.
shots.motion: Camera holds tight and drifts a hair left as the hands work. Cold-stiff fingers of the man from the reference image lift the spare brass burner nozzle clear of the oilcloth tool roll, adjust the grip when it nearly slips, and thumb grit from its threads, leaving a clean bright arc in the tarnish. One continuous take. SFX: brass scraping cloth, a short breath, thumb rasping metal. Ambient noise: rain, the ship's bell faint off-screen.

shots.title: threading-the-burner
shots.firstFrame: Close shot, eye-level, of the man from the reference image off-center right, facing frame-left, reaching between the open brass cage rings of the great lamp, which is dead and dark. The spare brass burner nozzle is half-seated in the burner housing. Out-of-focus lens prisms fracture the amber hand-lantern light across the foreground.
shots.motion: Camera arcs a few degrees left around the brass rings. The man from the reference image turns the spare brass burner nozzle into the housing, feels it cross-thread, backs it off with a muttered breath, and seats it true on the second try, oil smearing dark across the bright brass. One continuous take. SFX: metal threads catching, a spanner's quarter-turn ratchet, a sharp exhale. Ambient noise: rain hammering, wind rising, the ship's bell off-screen closer now.

shots.title: fuel-and-hesitation
shots.firstFrame: Medium close shot, slightly low camera height, of the man from the reference image off-center left, facing frame-left, hand resting on the fuel valve of the great lamp, which remains dead and dark with the spare brass burner nozzle now seated and gleaming. His eyes stay on the burner. Blurred brass cage rings frame the right foreground; the hand-lantern burns behind.
shots.motion: Camera holds, then eases in slightly on his face. The man from the reference image opens the fuel valve a half-turn, freezes at the hiss, and lets his shoulders drop as kerosene wets the seated brass burner nozzle and drips a dark bead onto the pedestal. His breath fogs. One continuous take. SFX: pressurized hiss, a valve squeal, one liquid drip. Ambient noise: the ship's bell hard off-screen right, rain, wind through the gallery door.

shots.title: ignition
shots.firstFrame: Wide shot, low camera height from the floorboards, of the room from the reference image. The man from the reference image stands off-center right, facing frame-left, leaning in through the brass rings with a storm match from the oilcloth tool roll. The great lamp is still dead and dark, the spare brass burner nozzle wet with fuel. The tool roll lies open in the foreground.
shots.motion: Camera pushes in slowly, then holds. The man from the reference image strikes a storm match from the oilcloth tool roll, shields it as wind kills it, strikes a second, and touches it to the spare brass burner nozzle; the great lamp catches and burns, flooding the rings with white light and leaving a scorch of soot on the burner throat. He turns his face from the heat. One continuous take. SFX: match rasp, a soft ignition thump, glass ringing. Ambient noise: rain, wind, the ship's bell off-screen.

shots.title: the-beam-finds-her
shots.firstFrame: Exterior wide shot, high camera height from seaward, no person in frame, storm dusk. The lighthouse tower stands off-center left, its lantern room blazing; the great lamp now burns and its beam cuts through rain. Wet black rock fills the near foreground. Far off-center right, one small ship's light rides the swell beside the white water of the reef.
shots.motion: Camera cranes slowly back and right as rain crosses the lens. The beam from the now-burning great lamp sweeps across the water, strikes the reef white, and holds on the small ship, which turns hard away, its wake bending a bright curve into the black swell. One continuous take. SFX: surf detonating on rock, a foghorn answering off-screen, rigging clatter. Ambient noise: wind across open water, rain on stone.
